nom: Clinique Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator Gel Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.titre: Not worth the money, not for truly dry skin
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this but any time I wear it it feels like it doesn't absorb and leaves a sticky feel to my face. My skin is dry and I don't think this product is best suited for true dry skin.
This moisturizer makes my skin glow! It feels light and airy on my face and my makeup goes on so easily.
I love this product! It moisturizes my 77 year old face. I feel like I'm glowing!
I have aged combo skin, this moisturizer works wonderful for me. Very lightweight bur effective.
This is so lightweight and and luxuriously hydrating. I love that it is refreshing and easy to apply for a smooth result.
This is my go to daily morning moisturizer, it's light and doesn't leave my skin feeling coated or greasy as some cream based moisturizer's can . Works well under primers and base makeup !
This moisturizer 100 is wonderful! Very moisturizing and you can use under eyes and on lids. Feels outstanding!

avis.titre: A must in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been using this for years. I started using it because someone on here who had sensitive skin like me and easily broke out gave it rave reviews. They weren't wrong! Has worked wonders for me! Super hydrating, good for sensitive skin, and doesn't cause breakouts (at least for me). I highly recommend!

avis.titre: This product is very light and feels very nice on the skin-
avis.texte: This product feels very nice on the skin and soaks in very quickly. I use in both under my makeup and as a night cream. I have very dry skin and it seems to help with that.
I love this moisturizer after applying a serum, it is quickly absorbed and does not leave an oily film on the skin. Excellent for hydration, I use it twice daily.
It left my skin very soft and hydrated. My skin is very sensitive and this didn't make me break out.
This is the ideal moisterizer if you have oily skin like mine. Im 23 and have been using this since like middle school and it helps so much to keep my skin moisterized without breaking me out.
This is one of the very few products I can use due to multiple allergies that cause unbearable hives. There is one unsafe( for me) ingredients but it's at the very end of the list. Love this product
I've been using a creamy moisturizer and thought I would try this one. Hands down, my moisturizer works much better than this one. It's a gel and doesn't live up to the hype.
This is my go to moisturizer day and night ! The texture is perfect and melts into your skin. It allows your skin to still breathe and is a perfect base under primer and foundation !!!

I have combo oily dehydrated skin and this is AMAZING. It's a gel, sinks deep into the skin and dries down leaving your skin feeling amazing. My absolute HG nothing can replace it. If you haven't tried this please do yourself a favor and do it. They have thicker formulas for dry skin but for normal, combo oily or oily this is exactly what your skin needs.
This moisturizer is my go-to. Not heavy. Not greasy. Even moisture with no heavy perfumes or stickiness. This is exactly what my skin loves - day or night!
I use this every day to soften my facial skin and make it look younger which is wonderful at my age.
i love this product somuch it is super hydrating and making my skin look young

I wanted to try this on my oily combo skin since I use the dramatically different gel. Unfortunately I will forever stick to the DDG since this made me breakout and caused and allergic reaction. Not too sure which ingredient caused it...
Went in looking for a gel moisturizer after seeing an esthetician. Consultant took me to this one and it was on sale. It leaves my skin moisturized but don't leave me looking greasy!
The texture of this moisturizer is amazing, feels just like silk. This will be my regular product now.

I have combo oily dehydrated skin and this is AMAZING. It's a gel, sinks deep into the skin and dries down leaving your skin feeling amazing. My absolute HG nothing can replace it. If you haven't tried this please do yourself a favor and do it. They have thicker formulas for dry skin but for normal, combo oily or oily this is exactly what your skin needs.
This moisturizer is my go-to. Not heavy. Not greasy. Even moisture with no heavy perfumes or stickiness. This is exactly what my skin loves - day or night!
I use this every day to soften my facial skin and make it look younger which is wonderful at my age.

avis.auteur: Wrinkly old lady (or so you say)
avis.titre: Moisture surge yes, free gift? Nah.
avis.texte: I LOVE moisture surge. I've used it for years. It lasts all day and is the only moisturizer that doesn't lead my skin to have dermatitis. (I've tried LOTS) Since I order this with all about eyes, I get a free gift from time to time. I happened to also order in my birthday month this time. Guess what!? For turning 47 I got not 1, but 3 jars of wrinkle corrector. :( What a message to send as I attempt to embrace the memories written on my face despite what some want me to erase. No thanks, Clinique. I'll keep the memories. Minus one star for not making me smile on my birthday.
i love this product somuch it is super hydrating and making my skin look young

I wanted to try this on my oily combo skin since I use the dramatically different gel. Unfortunately I will forever stick to the DDG since this made me breakout and caused and allergic reaction. Not too sure which ingredient caused it...
Went in looking for a gel moisturizer after seeing an esthetician. Consultant took me to this one and it was on sale. It leaves my skin moisturized but don't leave me looking greasy!
The texture of this moisturizer is amazing, feels just like silk. This will be my regular product now.

This is the only moisturizer that I can use on my face that does not break me out and that actually works. My skin is dry and flaky and this makes it smooth and soft. I could not ask for a better product.

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin, this will save you
avis.texte: I have severe eczema and any products I tried would give me a bad reaction. This product not only cleared up my dry spots but keeps my skin hydrated all day long. Doesn't get irritated when sweating as well.

avis.titre: Makes your skin so soft and smooth
avis.texte: This moisturizer works so well that even my husband started using it. He works in rough conditions, and I cannot believe how soft it makes his skin. It also helped clear up the psoriasis on his hairline. Love this product!

avis.titre: Amazing stuff and great for tattoos
avis.texte: Not only does this hydrate all day, it literally brightens my tattoos instantly and stays that way all day! Non greasy, fast dry time and silky skin! Just buy it!
This is the only moisturizer that has kept my skin hydrated when typically dry and flakey. I was using the yellow moisturizer by Clinique but my skin was extra dry. This stuff did the trick.

I bought a small jar to test and just finished it. The good: The gel texture glides on smoothly and is absorbed into my skin quickly. The not-so-good: The hydration is just okay when worn alone; it isn't as superb as advertised. I always feel the need to top it off with a lotion or Vanicream to seal in the moisture. Maybe it's due to my eczematic skin. I prefer the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion. I'm going to try the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel next as my third Clinique hydrating product to see if it offers a lighter texture with a higher level of moisture.

I got the Moisture Surge Hydrator as a sample a while back and I haven't been the same since. I became an instant fan and have bought it several times now. I just LOVE the way my skin looks and feels after using it: so soft, glowy but not shiny. A 10/10 product.

avis.titre: Easy to use and super hydrating
avis.texte: It doesn't leave me with any sticky residue and I love to use it right after I shave. It allows the moisturizer and SPF product. I use to soak into my skin rather than just sit on top. This has now become an integral part of my morning routine.
I've used this a few months ago, and used it so much I ran out so quick! I love the hydration it has, and have never had more clear, hydrated skin than while using it. Will repurchase!

My face always feels dry after I wash it. I am sorta tomboyish, so I don't like a whole process. But this item makes my face feel fresh, no longer dry, not oily at all and has a really light pleasant smell. I think it is great for people who are low maintenance. In winter, I use the moisture surge night mask. Love both.
I love this! It is the best I have used so far, to the point it have even ordered another. You won't be disappointed.

I found this product "by accident ". I received a sample size as part of free gift with purchase and didn't try it for quite a while. Now that I have, I'm obsessed. A tiny bit goes on so smoothly, my skin looks hydrated and the best part, it stays fresh all day. I apply it a little more generously overnight and I feel like I've had a facial while I was sleeping. I put it to the test during a recent plane trip and I didn't arrive at my destination feeling like my skin was parched and wrinkly. I've tried many Clinique moisturizers and other brands as well but this one is my current favorite.

This product is just OK... everytime I use it (been trying for over 10 years), no matter if it's before/after other products or with no products at all, I experience alot of pilling, which is unsightly and gets all over my shirt(s). Must explain why they give out so many free full-size samples of this stuff.

avis.titre: Try it when it's on sale.
avis.texte: This moisturizer is well worth the cost. I've purchased it twice when on sale. In fact, I buy two at a time. Now my daughter is using it. It absorbs quickly and doesn't look or feel greasy during the day. Makeup goes on smoothly and evenly within a few minutes. It doesn't crease in fine lines and doesn't turn orange or dry out and crack. If you have extremely dry skin, finish your makeup with a moisture surge face spray. It leaves a glowing layer without being greasy.
Super lightweight. Not sticky. Goes on super smooth with all day hydration!
Love this product so much. A little goes a long way making my skin feel so soft and moisturized.
I love this item! Very light weight. Even pairs well under makeup.

I have been using Clinique Moisture Surge for many years and have found that it works best for me in the summer months. It leaves my skin silky smooth and is a good moisturizing foundation for nighttime use and under sunscreen.
It's ok, not worth full price so if I buy again it would have to be a sale

This is truly hydrating! It's an ultra-light moisturizer that absorbs quickly and smoothly into the skin. I have dry skin, and I noticed an instant difference in hydration.It also leaves a wonderfully fresh feeling. The only thing I'd suggest is adding a spatula to make it easier to scoop from the jar. Other than that, I loved it!
I have combination skin and this was as effective as moisturizing with water. Do not recommend.

Wow! After years of searching for the perfect facial moisturizer I have found it! This is an absolute rockstar. I have done nothing but wash my face with the Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser and apply this on afterwards and I have noticed a huge improvement from the Dermalogica Hydroboost moisturizer I was using. My face feels amazing and my tone has considerably improved. On zoom calls my face looks radiant and oh so smooth!!! I'm sticking with this from here on out.

avis.titre: Like a cool drink of water
avis.texte: I am 50, I have combo skin, and have used moisture surge for over 20 years now. While my skin has changed over time, this product remains something that feels like "a cool drink of water" on my skin. It absorbs perfectly so I can wear it under makeup, and it soothes my skin at night after a long day. My skin always looks refreshed when I used this product, we are meant to be together for life!

avis.titre: Absolutely works wonders on dry skin
avis.texte: I was completely blown away by this moisturizer. It works. I have dy skin and I live in a dry climate. My skin looks and most of all feels wonderful. Moisturized all day. Not once during day does my skin felt tight from being dry. I waa using a different brand that is pretty pricey and decided to try this out. GladI did, Absolutely love it. I am purchasing the bigger size since it will be on sale for Ulta's beauty event. If you have dry skin give this a try. You won't regret it.

I am absolutely obsessed with Clinique's Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator. From the very first use, my skin felt instantly refreshed, plump, and deeply hydrated—like it had a full glass of water. The texture is lightweight and gel-like, so it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. I love that it's oil-free, which makes it perfect for everyday use, even under makeup. My skin stays soft and dewy all day, and I've noticed a real improvement in dryness and fine lines over time. What really stands out is how soothing it feels—especially when my skin is stressed or dehydrated. It gives that immediate cooling, calming effect that just feels amazing. If you're looking for a moisturizer that delivers long-lasting hydration and a healthy glow, this is 100% worth it. It's become a staple in my skincare routine and I honestly can't imagine going without it now.
Living in a dry environment, I prefer this moisturizer for the summer months, and the intense version for winter. If you can snag it on sale (usually happens about 2-3x per year), it's a steal!!

avis.titre: I will definitely buy it again.
avis.texte: I love how hydrating it is. It makes my skin feel so hydrated.

This is my number one go to for moisturizer! I do not go without it. I do feel its a bit pricey but I keep buti g it because it works! I have dry akin in the winter and this helps immensly! My teenager also uses it because its gentle and theres teally no fragrance to it at all! Clinique… if you read these review's you better never discontinue or change this product!

avis.titre: An all-around great moisturizer for everyone
avis.texte: I've been using this stuff off-and-on for I don't even know how many years now. I used it in my 20s, loved it, and now that I'm in my early 40s I can appreciate it even more. This is my go-to moisturizer when I have to wear make-up. It has a very light feel. Not greasy at all. It has never given me any kind of breakouts, even when I was younger. And it has a cool, refreshing feel when it goes on. Makes my skin look instantly rejuvenated. My mom also really likes this product, and she's in her 60s. It really is great for all ages.

avis.titre: Just what I was looking for
avis.texte: Most moisturizers are just too heavy for me. This works very well for me & no break outs or excess oil!
Perfect for all seasons its not heavy and good for makup its work like primers
The Moisture Surge is a great moisturizer. I prefer the gel over the cream. I recommend this product. I am 67 years old with dry skin.
This cream-gel has become the best moisturizer for my oily skin. I can't be without it.

So, I bought this item when it was 1/2 off. Finally used it 1 month later, today. While applying I said out loud, "I hope this works for me, because, I really like the application". Well, no sooner did those words come out of my mouth did this happen... (see attached picture). Guess I'll never know. All I can tell you is that the application is good.
Very lightweight, excellent under makeup, long-lasting moisture.
I tried the travel size first, and now I've bought the full size twice because I love it. I noticed my face looked more hydrated and plump from the first day.
I was satisfied with my purchase and service and would recommend to family and friends. I would buy this product again.
LOVE this product, goes on smooth and feels so nice on skin. Will definitely buy this product again.

avis.titre: My skin looks fresh and radiant.
avis.texte: It is a very refreshing, hydrating, and lightweight cream for daily use.

avis.titre: It's on my HAVE to have list
avis.texte: I am over 30 years old and my skin was super dry. I have tried numerous moisturizers and they would either cause me to break out or turn my skin red. This made my skin so hydrated and looks so healthy. I bought a small one to try it and I saw the results as soon as a week. I have bought this multiple times and plan to buy them again.

Love this product for both winter and summer weather. Its become my moisturizer staple. Even guilty of overusing in times when I'm low on water intake and light dehydration wrinkles show up. I just dab on a little extra to pump up the skin during the day.
I love Moisture Surge so much because it leaves my 74 year old skin dewy and soft. It doesn't leave an oily film like other moisture products. Have used for about 5 years now. Can't go without it!
This product goes on smooth and gives my face a great glow. Hydration is 100%. Its light going on. I highly recommend.
Nice feeling after applying. Smooth skin and fast in the skin
Finally formulating a skin care program. Finished my first jar and ordered more. I apply in the morning and my mature skin feels so soft. Recommend

Really like that Moisture Surge doesn't have a strong fragrance and that it's reasonably priced. Unfortunately, it caused my face to break out in a burning rash. Waited a few months and just tried it again because meh...what if it was me? Nah, Same thing happened. Really like the product but we weren't meant to be.

I LOVE this product. I dont know what I would do without her!! I am 21 years old, I have skin that is easily allergic to a lot of products, and have rosacea. I also get extremely dry skin year round that cracks and starts to burn. I have tried lathering myself in aquaphor and many different moisturizers but nothing works like this product. I put her on and she is ready to put makeup over in less than 3 minutes, and she doesn't cause my makeup to pill, which I love because both this moisturizer and my bb cream are water based. On my no makeup days, I only need to apply her once in the morning, and in the past I would need to reapply moisturizers almost 3 times a day. Like I mentioned above, I struggle with redness in the cheek area from rosacea and have noticed that going down signifigantly since I started using this product. It is so calming, hydrating, easy to use, and really lives up to its name. The only con is how expensive it is but it is definently worth it to claim any sales going on to give her a try! I don't know how my skin lived before this product!!
It's a nice gel moisturizer, but not as moisturizing as I need for a "senior".

Received this product as a sample. For my face, it is prescription only. But for fingernails? Oh my! After years of struggling with peeling, cracking splitting nails and trying every nail moisturizing product/hand lotion/cream and rubber glove protection constantly, I had given up. Never wear nail polish. On a whim, I tried using this moisture product on my nails. Just a wee bit. once or twice daily, after time nails were trimmed and shaped. My nails look hydrated. they are not brittle. they are not breaking. No more hang nails. Cuticles look healthy!!! Amazing! Especially in dry cold winter!

Great product with excellent quality and results. I have been using it to hydrate my skin after shaving. It make my skin feel better and smoother. I don't like the men after shaving product because of my sensitive skin.

I think it works and it doesn't clog the pores. I have combination skin that is prone to being oily, and the only other moisturizer that worked so far was from Purito brand. It is worth it if your skin isn't overly dry and if you're scared of breaking out.
On melanated skin often times moisturizers with spf leave a residue. This does not. Doesn't feel heavy on the skin.

Indoor heat has been a real threat to my skin. I knew i needed to change to something more creamy and absorbent. This was recommended to me and I'm so pleased with the results. It's not greasy, absorbs quickly, and helps my foundation stay fresh all day. You need ti try some tiday. You won't be sorry.
I was looking for a good moisturizer and this one was part of Ulta's January sale. It feels good on my skin and I'm glad I purchased it. I will definitely buy again!
Hands down my favorite skin quenching moisturizer. Lightweight but keeps my skin nice and hydrated without being oily.

avis.titre: I bought this moisture almost 2 weeks ago
avis.texte: It's amazing moisturizer I have ever had. My skin is dry. Keep my skin moisturized and feel good the website wrote some free stuff but when I go to pick up they told me sorry all stuff gone I cheek the web sight and buy the night I receive Emaile. How all stuff gone!
Received this as a sample. Glides easily on my skin and absorbs readily. A little goes a long way

I liked using this sample as my night cream in my routine. I only got it because it was a gift from a purchase I made. Would get as a gift for someone since I prefer a different brand for my daily use.
I'm over 40 and one of the Ulta workers recommended this. For the price i expected it to work great, instead my face started breaking out. Waste of money.

avis.titre: Did they reformulate it?Painful breakouts beware!
avis.texte: I just purchased a new one and right away i noticed that it felt thicker in consistency and brighter in color compared to the one i was almsot out of . I didnt think much of it so went ahead and used it as usual and within a few days it made me and my daughter break out into painful big pimples very hard to get rid of. I dont know if i got a bad batch this time or if it was reformulated ? it is such a bummer since both my daughter and i have loved this mosturizer for about 2 years until now :/ .

Tried this moisturizer as it had such great reviews but it didn't moisturize my skin at all. My face felt so dry a few minutes after applying. I even applied it 2 or 3 times a night thinking maybe I didnt use enough, but still very dry. Do not recommend.

I love this moisturizer, I think it's on par with Genifique without the price. It goes on smooth, not greasy. I have very dry skin and my face just drinks it in. Makes my skin look and feel smooth and soft.

I absolutely adore this product and use it religiously after a facial mist and before my Clinique dramatically different lotion plus, which I follow with a few drops of oil. It visibly plumps and hydrates my skin and helps it feel nourished and moisturized all day. When I run out, I can feel the difference. Other "hydro boosters" do not work nearly as well and burn my skin. I'll use this as long as they make it!

avis.titre: I buy this product all the time- great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I react to any facial products - My skin is super sensitive .. This is one of the few moisturizers that my face loves. I will use this product for as long as it if offered - It deeply moisturizes and keeps my skin soft and moist all day.

avis.titre: My personal fave that isn't medical grade!
avis.texte: Some products do more than others, and this is one of them! It does not let down in the hydration department. A little goes a long way. This has been a staple for me for years!

avis.titre: I have bought this product again and again
avis.texte: This is my favorite moisturizer. I recently recommended it to a friend who is suffering facial dryness due to medication.

I have an oily T-zone and this moisturizer works well for me. It goes right into my skin with no greasy residue. Does well under my Bare Minerals Make up and I'm not having any issues with oiliness during the day. I've tried many other brands thsi one works best for me and I will continue to use it.
I could tell a difference almost immediately. My face is so much softer and feels great! Highly recommend!

I love Clinique, because I have sensitive skin. This moisturizer is wonderful because it hydrates my skin without causing breakouts. I have combination skin so this helps even it out, and gives me healthy looking glow.
Ive been using it for about a year, it keeps my winter skin plump and soft
I am 69 with very few wrinkles. I've use this for years and will never stop. I put this on at night and when I wash my face you can still feel the moisture.

I was told this stuff is amazing but I don't have acne until I use this. I've tried on & off for a couple years. I have combination skin, oiler in summer dryer in winter and it doesn't matter when I use it. You can feel that it's just lying on the skin's surface & not penetrating it. I'm not sure what the hype is about. There's nothing hydrating about this for me. Just pimples. I would recommend the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion+ or Dramatically Different Hydrating Jelly. These feel way more natural, hydrating and my skin isn't gross after using them.
